prose.against: The case against rests mostly on growth: growth scores only 32 of 100 against the comparison pool. Other areas on this side: the quality of the business, the recent price trend, what the price implies.
prose.weighing: Weighing them: 8 points in favour and 6 against give more points in favour. The pool score is 34 of 100. The side that carries most weight is the recent price trend.
